name: Craic Den Comedy Club
address: The Workman's Club, 10 Wellington Quay, Dublin 8, D02 VX36
scrapeNotes: Listings grid is loaded by JS after page load — plain HTML fetch returns only the filter UI. Scrape the Eventbrite organiser instead, or render with a headless browser. robots.txt only disallows WooCommerce/cart/admin paths.
blurb: Ireland's highest-rated comedy club on Google — the best Irish and international comedians, seven nights a week at The Workman's Club on the quays. Also runs a second room at PYE Dundrum.

name: International Comedy Club
address: The International Bar, 23 Wicklow Street, Dublin 2, D02 VH59
scrapeNotes: Standard server-rendered WordPress, wraps individual Eventbrite events at /eventbrite-event/<slug>/. Note the club also uses theinternationalcomedyclub.com. Prices differ between the general tickets page and the Thu/Fri/Sat page — needs a human check.
blurb: The room above the International Bar on Wicklow Street — a Dublin comedy institution for over 30 years. Different night every day of the week: Stitches on Tuesday, the Comedy Cellar on Wednesday, the main club Thursday to Saturday, the Underground late on Saturday and Dublin Comedy Improv on Sunday.

name: Laughter Lounge
scrapeNotes: Could not be fetched during research — needs a direct check. Dated shows live at /collections/<month-dates-year>. Also sells through Fever (feverup.com) and has a Ticketmaster venue page.
blurb: Ireland's purpose-built comedy theatre on Eden Quay — four comedians a bill, every Friday and Saturday night at 7.30pm.

name: Pitchfork Comedy
address: J. T. Pim's, 4 South Great George's Street, Dublin 2, D02 NR59
scrapeNotes: No standalone website. Eventbrite recurring event — the individual date list is JS-rendered and not visible to a plain fetch. Needs a headless browser or the Eventbrite API.
blurb: A weekly stand-up night at J. T. Pim's on South Great George's Street — new comedians every week with headline sets from some of the country's best. Pints €6.

name: The Comedy Crunch
address: The Stag's Head, 1 Dame Court, Dublin 2
scrapeNotes: Free walk-in night with no booking, so there are no individually ticketed dates to scrape — treat as a standing residency. The club's own site says Sun/Mon/Tue; the Stag's Head says Sun/Mon. Needs confirming.
blurb: Free-entry stand-up institution in the basement of The Stag's Head. Doors 8.15pm, show at 9pm, free ice cream at the interval. No bookings taken — turn up early, it fills fast.

name: Cherry Comedy
scrapeNotes: Own site is server-rendered and readable, but the /tickets/ page was showing past dates during research — check freshness before trusting it. Whelan's own ticket page is JS-gated.
blurb: Every Thursday at Whelan's on Wexford Street, running since 2014 — a reputation for breaking new Irish acts.

name: CoCo Comedy Club
address: The Roundy, 1 Castle Street, Cork, T12 RX09
scrapeNotes: Own site is server-rendered but carries no dates; all listings live on Eventbrite, which fetches cleanly. Best-behaved source of the twelve.
blurb: Upstairs in The Roundy on Castle Street — Cork's busiest comedy room, four nights a week. Free-entry new material on Wednesday, a variety showcase on Thursday, headliners on Friday, and two shows on Saturday.

name: City Limits Comedy Club
address: 16 Coburg Street, Victorian Quarter, Cork, T23 HEF9
scrapeNotes: IMPORTANT: the club's own /gigs/ calendar is a broken JS widget that renders 'No events found' — it looks closed but is not. Real listings currently only reachable via entertainment.ie and purecork.ie. Flag to the venue; ask for a feed.
blurb: Cork's longest-running comedy room, on Coburg Street in the Victorian Quarter since the early 90s — Irish and international headliners plus the Best of Cork resident nights.

name: Róisín Dubh
scrapeNotes: Listings page is a JS app — a plain fetch returns only the site template. Needs a headless browser. The homepage does expose a 'tonight's show' widget.
blurb: The west's essential comedy night — the Tuesday Comedy Showcase at 8.30pm, mixing established names with emerging talent, in Galway's best-known music venue.

name: The Empire Comedy Club
address: The Empire Music Hall, 42 Botanic Avenue, Belfast, BT7 1JQ
scrapeNotes: Individual event pages are clean server-rendered HTML and scrape well; the overview grid uses a JS plugin. Event URLs are ugly auto-generated slugs, so match on date not URL.
blurb: The Empire Laughs Back — Belfast's longest-running and most revered comedy club, every Tuesday in a converted Victorian church on Botanic Avenue. Doors 7.30pm, show 9pm, free pint of Harp for the first fifty in, live music afterclub to follow.

name: Lavery's Comedy Club
scrapeNotes: Use laverys.com, not laverysbelfast.com (unreachable during research). Page text is server-rendered but the show list itself sits in a JS booking widget; there is also a ti.to page at ti.to/laveryscomedyclub.
blurb: Comedy on the middle floor of Belfast's most famous bar, curated by Colin Geddis — every Wednesday and Thursday, doors at 8pm.

name: Dolan's
scrapeNotes: Best-behaved venue site of the twelve — /comedy is fully server-rendered with titles, dates and ticket links. Times and prices are NOT on the listing page; they need a second fetch of each Yapsody page.
blurb: Limerick's home of live comedy on the Dock Road — touring stand-up and one-off shows across the venue's rooms, ticketed through Yapsody.

name: Vicar Street
blurb: Ireland's favourite mid-size theatre — where every touring comic wants to play.

name: 3Olympia Theatre
blurb: The grand old Dame Street theatre — home to comedy's biggest nights out.
